cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
from rdkit.Chem.rdchem import BondType

# two azaaromatic ligands
m1=Chem.MolFromSmiles('C1=CC2=C3C(=CC=C4C=CC=NC4=C3)N=CC2=C1') # phenanthroline
m2=Chem.MolFromSmiles('c1ccc2ncccc2c1') # quinoline
rw=Chem.RWMol(Chem.CombineMols(m1,m2))
off=m1.GetNumAtoms()
# utility atoms/add bonds

def atom(el,charge=0):
    a=Chem.Atom(el); a.SetFormalCharge(charge); return rw.AddAtom(a)
def bond(i,j,t=BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(int(i),int(j),t)

# atom IDs
Sb=atom('Sb'); Cu=atom('Cu'); oxo=atom('O')
Oaryl=atom('O')
# 2 adjacent O-bearing carbons of tetrachlorophenyl ether
ring=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
for i in range(6): bond(ring[i],ring[(i+1)%6],BondType.AROMATIC)
for i in range(6): rw.GetAtomWithIdx(ring[i]).SetIsAromatic(True)
for i in range(6):
  # set aromatic bonds' endpoint atoms aromatic
  pass
Oquin=atom('O')
# Cl substituted 4 other ring positions (2-5)
for i in range(2,6):
  cl=atom('Cl'); bond(ring[i],cl)
# triflate
Otf=atom('O'); S=atom('S'); Ot1=atom('O'); Ot2=atom('O'); Cf=atom('C'); F=[atom('F') for _ in range(3)]
# bonds
bond(Cu,Otf); bond(Otf,S); bond(S,Ot1,BondType.DOUBLE); bond(S,Ot2,BondType.DOUBLE); bond(S,Cf)
for f in F: bond(Cf,f)
# metal complex links
# Sb=O
bond(Sb,oxo,BondType.DOUBLE)
# Sb-O-phenyl
bond(Sb,Oaryl); bond(Oaryl,ring[1])
# phenyl-O-quinoline at adjacent site
bond(ring[0],Oquin); bond(Oquin,off+2)
# Sb-C phenanthroline and Cu coordination
bond(Sb,10)
bond(Cu,11)
bond(Cu,off+4)
bond(Cu,Sb)

m=rw.GetMol()
# form aromaticity and hydrogens
try:
  Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
  print('sanitized',m.GetNumAtoms(), Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
except Exception as e:
  print('sanitize failed',e)
  raise
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('total',m.GetNumAtoms())
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=31337; params.maxIterations=1000
params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
cid=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed id',cid)
if cid<0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
# relax MMFF if supports
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
print('mmff props',props is not None)
if props:
  ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props)
  if ff: print('mmff',ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000))
# save xyz
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('start.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\ninitial connected complex\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}\n')
# output bond list for diagnostic
PY

def atom(el): return rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
def bond(i,j,t=BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(int(i),int(j),t)
Sb=atom('Sb'); Cu=atom('Cu')
ring=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
for i in range(6): bond(ring[i],ring[(i+1)%6],BondType.AROMATIC)
for i in range(6): rw.GetAtomWithIdx(ring[i]).SetIsAromatic(True)
Oa=atom('O'); Ob=atom('O')
bond(Sb,Oa); bond(Oa,ring[0]); bond(Sb,Ob); bond(Ob,ring[1])
